name: paste-cliff-lacking
description: test.md 'Pasting ground whose cliff type the map lacks': ground copied in one map and pasted into another whose cliff list lacks the cliff's type. Input paste-cliff-src.w3x (tests/fixtures/we-specs/make-melee-valid.mjs <cli> <game> --out DIR --case 'cliffsrc={"corners":[[30,30,34,34,{"layer":3}]]}': flat.w3x, cliffs CLdi CLgr, a plateau one level up with its cliff corners typed 1, CLgr); the second map nv-L-CAgr-CLdi.w3x (make-water-tilesets.mjs <cli> <game> <out> --dry --cliffs CAgr,CLdi L). The World Editor: the terrain palette (t) with nothing applied is the selection brush; a drag round the plateau (546,243 to 954,708 at the opening camera: the middles of tiles 27, 36 and 35, 25, by the projection of docs/testing/cameras-and-views.md), Ctrl+C, the second map opened in the same editor, Ctrl+V, a click at 722,444 (the ground point 31.5, 31 tiles: the copied area's middle, so the plateau lands where it was copied, corners 30 to 34). Measured 2026-11-19 (branch we-compare-18): the editor keeps the corners' cliff number as it was (1, CLdi in this list: no lookup by name), appends nothing and says nothing. Studio (the Select tab's Area, the same drag, w3.terrain.copy / paste across the two projects, the same click; see paste-cliff-same-number for the pixel) looks the type up by name: CLgr is missing, the first type (0, CAgr) stands in and a warning says so (fragment.ts cliffNumbers); it also adds that type's ground Agrs to the ground list (header.ground[6], which the editor leaves). Expected differences: the 40 cliff corners, 1 against 0, and the ground list

steps.eval: [...document.querySelectorAll('.terrain-group-tools button.chip')].find((b) => b.textContent === 'Area').click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300));

const c = document.querySelector('.model-stage canvas'); c.focus(); await w3.commands.execute('w3.terrain.copy'); const dir = w3.workspace.project().root + '-target'; await w3.backend.invoke('project_unpack', { map: '${REPO}/tests/fixtures/we-specs/nv-L-CAgr-CLdi.w3x', dir, allowIncomplete: false }); await w3.editors.closeAll(); await w3.workspace.open(dir); for (let i = 0; i < 100 && w3.workspace.project()?.root !== dir; i++) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100)); if (w3.workspace.project()?.root !== dir) throw new Error('the second map did not open');
const c = document.querySelector('.model-stage canvas'); c.focus(); await w3.commands.execute('w3.terrain.paste'); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300));

const c = document.querySelector('.model-stage canvas'); c.focus(); for (const type of ['keydown', 'keyup']) c.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent(type, { key: 'Escape', code: 'Escape', bubbles: true })); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300));

name: paste-cliff-same-number
